notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), and no hardware was attached or run.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0], core/go2/scene.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0. The scene includes the robot model core/go2/go2.xml and adds a floor plane (scene.xml:1-2, 19-21). cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [...]}}; the bridge derives one control interval per actuator from the loaded model's actuator_ctrlrange (twelve motors: eight -23.7 to 23.7 and four -45.43 to 45.43, go2.xml:10, 24, 224-237), checks every element before writing data.ctrl, then mj_step runs ticks times. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward. The state is the bridge's integration state (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed); the free base starts at the body pos -7.5 0 0.5 of go2.xml:64.

WHY THIS SHAPE: the card's family-config/MujocoDriver decision matches the upstream, a MuJoCo sim2sim environment for the Unitree GO2. The card's entry symbol mujoco_deploy.mujoco_env:MujocoEnv was confirmed at mujoco_deploy/mujoco_env.py:9; it loads the MJCF with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path (:53-54), resets with mj_resetData (:71-72) and steps with mj_step (:93), and this driver serves the same model through the SDK's MuJoCo bridge without importing or running the demo. The upstream deployment entry point loads core/go2/scene_parkour.xml with the height-field terrain (core/deployment_player.py:21-22); this package serves models[0], core/go2/scene.xml, following the exemplar's one-package-one-model convention, and the parkour scene is not served.

FAKE: MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module in fake.py. It expands the scene's go2.xml include, resolves the MJCF default classes (including the nested hip class), and derives the twelve actuator control ranges, the 19 qpos / 18 qvel dimensions and the option time step from the same text. Its integration is a placeholder joint velocity, not MuJoCo's dynamics; it loads no mesh, resolves no contact and computes no inertia, torque, sensor or noise model. The model states no option timestep (go2.xml:4), so the stand-in uses a placeholder 2 ms library default and the bridge publishes that value. Every difference is in the driver's fidelity gaps. The real mujoco path (backend sim) was not run here.

WARNINGS (all expected, none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because backends['fake'] is the FakeMujoco class object (the stand-in mujoco namespace) rather than a '.fake:...' string, so the gate treats the fake as an upstream simulator and cannot wrap it in a Recorder; the bridge-boundary behaviour checks still run (G6) and the gate has no fake surface to compare (G7). G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, the bridge-derived inputs the exemplar also leaves without units. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised; G1-G5 and G9 passed, and G6, G7 and G8 raised only the expected warnings.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds six cases (model shape from the card scene and the free-base pose, per-actuator control-range refusals with zero effect, state following the control target, reset, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); they pass. No catalogue_requests: the package uses only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1. No operator_required limit and no site-limits overlay: the model file is the system of record for the control envelope.

NOT COVERED: the upstream camera, depth and contact sensor arrays (mujoco_deploy/mujoco_wrapper.py:28-40) are not carried by the world capabilities and are not served; the world state carries only time, qpos, qvel and ctrl. The upstream policy, observation history and joystick command are not part of this driver. The real MuJoCo engine was never imported, so no trajectory was compared with it, and no physical GO2 is modelled or was validated. The upstream clone was not modified (G1 pass).
